race.description: Scott Camery Welding Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: VICIOUS RUMOUR (4) brings the most convincing overall case, having won at this track and distance two runs ago before a sound sixth in a Class 2 at Warren when beaten three and a half lengths. The return to 1000m, third-up profile and proven record with Jacob Stiff all point to a sharp rebound. CAN DO IT (7) is the immediate danger after consecutive close runs in BM50 grade at this venue, most recently second as favourite, and his track-and-distance record gives him a genuine platform despite rising in grade. JACOB JOE (14) also rises from a BM50 picnic win at Moruya, but he is third-up, gets the claim and has a deep 1000m record to keep him in play. SPRING PROSPECT (9) was only fifth behind Marinera at Warren, yet she had won a Class 1 at Mudgee the start prior and that Warren line ties her in with VICIOUS RUMOUR, so she has enough recent substance to threaten again.
